items.definition:
relating to the period before a legal trial
The judge scheduled a pretrial hearing to discuss the evidence.

relating to a period of testing or observation
New employees often have a probationary period of three months.

relating to the work of a secretary or to an office
She applied for a secretarial position at the law firm.

not expected or predicted
The storm caused unanticipated delays.

putting others' needs before one's own
Her unselfish act of kindness touched everyone.

not safe or robust; not based on sound reasoning
The bridge was deemed unsound and closed to traffic.

not confirmed or proved to be true
The report contained unverified claims.

Able to be understood.
The instructions were clear and comprehensible.

Soft, loose, and lacking firmness.
After weeks of no exercise, his muscles felt flabby.

fond of company; sociable
She is a very gregarious person who loves parties.

causing hatred or disgust
His loathsome behavior made everyone uncomfortable.

somewhat purple
The sky had a purplish hue at sunset.

thin and bony
The stray cat was scrawny and hungry.

broad and sturdily built
He was a stocky man with strong shoulders.

bad-tempered and sulky; gloomy
He was sullen and quiet after the argument.

lukewarm; showing little enthusiasm
He took a tepid bath to relax.

not deserved or gained by effort
He felt guilty about his unearned success.

Not yet read.
I have a pile of unread books on my nightstand.

Resembling wax in texture or appearance.
The plant has waxy leaves that help it retain moisture.

pleasantly warm
We enjoyed a balmy evening on the beach.

Relating to or derived from citrus fruit.
Lemon juice has a strong citric acid taste.

resembling a nightmare; terrifying
The traffic jam was a nightmarish experience.

decaying or rotting and emitting a fetid smell
The putrid smell from the garbage bin filled the air.

able to be reproduced or copied
For a scientific experiment to be valid, its results must be reproducible.

hanging down loosely or unevenly
The old sofa cushions had become saggy over time.

feeling or showing sorrow or sadness
Her face was sorrowful as she listened to the bad news.

lacking in inspiration or originality
His latest work was rather uninspired and dull.

not hygienic or healthy
The conditions in the old kitchen were completely unsanitary.

never growing old or appearing to grow old
Her beauty seemed ageless, defying the passage of time.

responsible for something; accountable
The manager is answerable to the board of directors.

without bloodshed or violence; lacking vitality or spirit
The revolution was surprisingly bloodless, with no lives lost.

slightly salty (of water)
The estuary contained brackish water, a mix of fresh and salt.

in agreement or harmony; (geometry) identical in form
The two triangles are congruent, meaning they have the same size and shape.

able to be divided
Twelve is divisible by three.

disloyal or unfaithful
She felt betrayed by her faithless friend.

self-willed and obstinate
Her headstrong nature often led her into arguments.

extremely large; huge
They built a humongous sandcastle on the beach.

having a pleasant appearance and manner
He was a very personable young man, easy to talk to.

not genuine; fake
He tried to pass off a phoney banknote.

able to be repeated
For the experiment to be valid, the results must be repeatable.

extremely virtuous or pious
She was known for her saintly patience and kindness.

short and thick
The dog had stubby legs.

late
He was tardy for the meeting again.

not seeming true or real
His excuse for being late was unconvincing.

not earned or merited
His punishment was completely undeserved.

not expressed or spoken
There were many unsaid feelings between them.

smooth and soft like velvet
The rose petals had a velvety texture.

resembling chalk in texture or color
The old paint had a chalky finish.

easy to digest; easy to understand
This food is easily digestible for sensitive stomachs.

bringing shame or disgrace
His actions were considered dishonorable by the entire community.

standing alone; not supported by another structure
The kitchen has a freestanding island in the center.

not precise; vague or inaccurate
The instructions were imprecise and difficult to follow.

impossible to harm or damage
Superman is often portrayed as invulnerable.

nervous or uneasy
She felt jittery before her big presentation.

Larger than the usual or standard size
He bought an oversize sweater for comfort.

shaky, unstable
The old bridge looked rickety and unsafe.

overly sentimental; foolishly emotional
The romantic comedy was a bit too sappy for my taste.

not formally connected or associated; not in a romantic relationship
She preferred to remain unattached and independent.

difficult or impossible to manage or control
The project became unmanageable due to its complexity.

not affected by emotion or persuasion; not having changed position
He remained unmoved by her pleas.

lively and animated
She has a vivacious personality that lights up any room.

hostile; aggressive; ready for war
The country's warlike rhetoric worried its neighbors.

relating to baptism
The church has a beautiful baptismal font.

Risky; uncertain.
The weather conditions made the climb a bit dicey.
